tcodes.name: Create Production Order

tcodes.name: Stock/Requirements List

tcodes.name: HR Personnel Actions
tcodes.description: Wizard transaction to execute hire, transfer, promotion, or termination lifecycles.

tcodes.name: User Maintenance

TIME_OUT.title: TIME_OUT (Process Run Time Limit Exceeded)
TIME_OUT.cause: A dialog work process executed an ABAP query that exceeded the maximum runtime threshold (usually 600 seconds) defined by parameter 'rdisp/max_wprun_time'.
steps: Check ST22 dump log to find the exact database SQL select statement that hung.
Add indexes to database tables being queried if search fields are non-indexed.
Optimize the ABAP code to select only required fields instead of using 'SELECT *'.
If the process is a long-running reporting tool, schedule it to run as a Background Batch Job (SM36) rather than a Dialog Process.

ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY.title: ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY (Duplicate Key Insertion in Sorted/Unique Table)
ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY.cause: The program attempted to insert a line item into an internal table defined with a UNIQUE KEY, but a record with that key already existed.
steps: Review the dump statement in ST22 to see the key values of the record being inserted.
Ensure data inputs or database SELECT statements do not retrieve duplicate primary keys.
Modify the ABAP program to use 'INSERT ... ASSIGNING ...' or check existence using 'READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS' before inserting.

GETWA_NOT_ASSIGNED.title: GETWA_NOT_ASSIGNED (Field Symbol Reference Unassigned)
GETWA_NOT_ASSIGNED.cause: The ABAP code attempted to read or modify a Field Symbol (pointer) that has not been initialized or assigned to a valid memory area.
steps: Identify the unassigned field symbol name in the ST22 source code dump extract.
Check if a database read failed (e.g. subrc != 0) before the field symbol assignment was checked.
Add defensive programming: always check 'IF <fs_symbol> IS ASSIGNED' before accessing the fields.

SQL_ARRAY_INSERT_DUPREC.title: SQL_ARRAY_INSERT_DUPREC (Duplicate Primary Key in Database)
SQL_ARRAY_INSERT_DUPREC.cause: The program tried to insert a record into a database table using an SQL INSERT statement, but a row with the exact same primary key values already exists in that database table.
steps: Identify the target database table from ST22 (e.g., BKPF or LQUA).
Check the Number Range interval for the document type (T-Code: SNRO). The number range status is likely out of sync with the highest document ID in the database.
Readjust the next number range status upwards to ensure it generates unique document IDs.
